articles.title: In India, the new iPhone can arrive faster than a pizza
articles.description: Availability of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series turned patchy within hours of its debut on India's quick-commerce apps.
articles.summary: In India, there are reports that Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series experienced inconsistent availability through quick-commerce apps shortly after its release. points: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series launch in India faced supply issues within hours of its release.
The demand for the iPhone 18 Pro series in India exceeded supply, leading to fast delivery times.
The iPhone 18 Pro series availability situation in India is likened to the speed of pizza delivery.
articles.insight: The news illustrates the immense popularity and demand for the latest Apple iPhone models in India, leading to supply and demand challenges that affect customer availability and experience.

articles.title: Dario Amodei and other AI leaders want to ‘Pace the Frontier’ but…how?
articles.description: A week after an Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning rattled the AI world, the company’s CEO Dario Amodei has outlined his plan to “pace the frontier” of AI development. The proposal leans on independent safety evaluators and coordination between AI labs in democratic countries, and it’s already picked up some industry support, along with some pointed pushback from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang. Watch […]
articles.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, proposes a collaborative and safe approach to AI development, involving independent safety evaluators and coordination between AI labs in democracies. Nvidia's head, Jensen Huang, and others in the industry have varying responses to Amodei's plan.
points: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, has proposed a plan to pace AI development involving independent safety evaluators.
The plan focuses on collaboration and coordination between AI labs in democratic countries.
Jensen Huang, head of Nvidia, responded with a pointed pushback to Amodei's plan.
articles.insight: Amodei's proposal represents a call for more regulated and safer AI development practices, which could lead to industry-wide standards and potentially mitigate some of the concerns regarding AI's rapid advancement.
